newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee, cocoa end lower, sugar off highs.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee, cocoa end lower, sugar off highs.

text.p: COCOA - Earlier weakness compounded by NY as buyers stay away. March last traded four stg lower at 903 stg. SUGAR - Drifts off highs but light trade buying supports. March $1.70 higher at $306.80 at 1707 GMT. COFFEE - Drifts down in light trade dominated by switches and AAs. March last traded $7 lower at $1,236.
